title: Data Quality Analyst
description:
Data Quality Analyst

Salary: Up to £80k base + benefits

Location: London, 2x a week in office
Working Pattern: Permanent


I'm currently representing my client are a professional services organisation, who are looking to hire a Data Quality Analyst to join their Technology & Data function.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience across data quality, data governance and data management to play a key role in improving the accuracy, consistency and reliability of business-critical data.


The Role:


  • Support the implementation and ongoing improvement of data quality standards, processes and controls across the business.
  • Work closely with business and technology stakeholders to identify, investigate and resolve data quality issues.
  • Develop and maintain data quality monitoring, reporting, dashboards and scorecards.
  • Support data governance activities, including documenting data flows, ownership, lineage and controls.
  • Act as a central point of contact for data quality matters, coordinating issues and proposing practical solutions.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to embed data quality principles and best practices across business processes.


The Requirements:


  • Proven experience in a Data Quality, Data Governance or Data Management-focused role.
  • Good understanding of data quality principles, including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness and validity.
  • Experience working with data quality systems, processes and monitoring frameworks.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to investigate issues and communicate solutions effectively.
  • Experience producing data quality reporting, dashboards and documentation.
  • Understanding of data governance principles, metadata, data lineage, ownership models and control frameworks.


What Will Make You Stand Out:


  • Experience working within a large, complex organisation.
  • Exposure to data governance frameworks and regulatory requirements.
  • The ability to translate technical data issues into practical business recommendations.
  • Experience working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A proactive approach to improving data quality processes, standards and ways of working.


If you are interested in the role, please apply. To follow up please message me on LinkedIn.
